description.zh: 云手机实例ID列表，可设置 1~100 个。
description.en: A list of 1 to 100 cloud phone instance IDs.

descriptions.zh: 只有实例处于 **非异常**（**UNAVAILABLE**）状态，且成功分配**私网IP**时才支持启动。
descriptions.en: This feature can be enabled when the instance is not in the **UNAVAILABLE** state and has a **private IP address** assigned.
